heatHelp: Each circle is one day. Columns are weeks: the far right is this week, older weeks to the left. Rows are weekdays, Monday at the top to Sunday at the bottom. The colour shows the average state of the day; an empty ring means a day with only feelings or text, and a dim circle a day without entries. Tap a day to see its entries.

wWhatBody:
Self-reflection is a calm look inward: what you feel, what you think about, what matters to you. It isn't self-criticism, but attention and curiosity towards yourself.

For example, you feel irritated and ask yourself: what exactly touched a nerve? What was missing? What might help?

Writing makes thoughts clearer, and over time you can see what fills you up and what drains you.
wLead: A quiet place for your thoughts, without rush or judgement. Come back whenever you like.
w1: Page. A moment to pause and listen to yourself. You can answer questions or write freely about anything.
w2: Path. All your entries are kept here with date and time. You can reread, add to or edit them.
w3: Share. Send a copy of entries from chosen days, for example to a therapist or someone close.
w4: Appearance. Colours, dark or light mode, atmosphere, font and language, so it feels like yours.
wPrivacy: Your entries are private and encrypted on your device: without your password no one can read them, not even the app's author. Sign in with Google or email so they're saved.
